description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Close a chat conversation

Closes a chat conversation and finalises it: the closing time is stamped and the response time and duration figures of the thread are recomputed, which is what the analytics endpoints then report. Chat threads only, a voice call id is rejected with 400. This endpoint takes no request body. Closing an already closed conversation runs the finalisation again rather than failing. The closed conversation is returned in `data`.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.

name: close_conversation
